items.doc: David N. Baker SI-NEA oral history (2)
items.title: David N. Baker — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: the band itself had as its rhythm section Ray Brown, Shelly Manne

ctx.x: Yeah, piano trio. And he had recorded my concerto for flute and jazz band [Concerto for Flute, String Quartet, and Jazz Band] and the Concerto for Violin and Jazz Band. He used a group on the West Coast for the Concerto for Violin and Jazz Band. It was James Getzoff on violin, and the band itself had as its rhythm section Ray Brown, Shelly Manne – and I can’t for the life of me remember who the piano player

was [Michael Lang], but it had all the best players on the West Coast in it. So that was something that we had gotten together, and he was very impressed. I think the second record I did for Laurel Record was Starker Plays Baker. It was a piece for Janos – it was an album that featured Janos Starker, on one side with my cello sonata and on the other side with a piece for 17 percussion instruments and cello, which was called . . .
